headline: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
summary: All were taken to Boulogne-sur-Mer for treatment, with 11 minor injuries and no fatalities reported.
script: More than one hundred and seventy people have been rescued after a migrant boat caught fire in the English Channel. French and British crews brought everyone safely ashore, with only minor injuries reported.
imageAlt: Migrants disembark from the French rescue ship Minck following their rescue at sea.
imageAltTwo: The Argonaute, one of two French ships involved in the rescue, docked in Boulogne-sur-Mer.
